about: Held-out probes on the 19 chemical-engineering papers chosen by the rule in PLAN.md (fetch.py; no paper passed for membrane separation), written from each paper's pdftotext text (plain and -layout; not its clause base, not ugrc's atoms, not any document an arm builds, not any model answer) before any run, 2026-10-30. cat, as in ../cheme/probes.json: C lookup, B binding trap (a near value for another entity is printed nearby), T table, X computation, H chained lookup, F false premise, A absence. expect cites the paper's table or section. must: every group must occur in the answer (alternatives inside a group; NEG = any absence wording); it is a hint for the grader, who grades by hand.
